Name: Herdr Deck
Description: Mirror your Herdr session onto the Stream Deck: live workspace tiles with repository, branch, and agent status. Press a tile to focus that workspace. Works with every agent Herdr runs — Claude Code, Codex, Pi, opencode, Cursor, Grok, Copilot, Hermes, and more (21 detected out of the box).
Author: Thomas Rooney
